PcosCycleFertility.1:
Cycle, ovulation,
d tmerna deg PCOS
PcosCycleFertility.6: Ɣer PCOS, cycle-ik yezmer ad yuɣal d aɣezfan, ur yelli ara d amaḍal, kra n tikkal yewɛer ad t-id-tsewweḍ. Ma tfehmeḍ ayen i d-yeḍran ɣer ovulation, ad k-yɛawen ad tfehmeḍ cycle-ik d yisteqsiyen yeqqnen ɣer tmerna.
PcosCycleFertility.8: Ayɣer i yettuɣal cycle ur yelli ara d amaḍal
PcosCycleFertility.9: D acu i d-yeḍran ɣer ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.12: Ayɣer i izemren ad ilin yisnasen d ilmend n wacemma
PcosCycleFertility.14: Melmi ara twaliḍ aṭṭbib ma tebɣiḍ ad tmerneḍ
PcosCycleFertility.16: Cycle n lḥiḍ yettɛalaq ɣer waṭas n yicaren n hormone yettuddmen. Deg PCOS, tuddsa-a tezmer ad tettwaffeɣ, s wudem uslig deg usnerni n follicule d ovulation.
PcosCycleFertility.17: Iseksawen zemren ad sɛun aṭas n follicule imeẓẓyanen i yebdan ad snernin war ma yewweḍ yiwen ad yeẓẓi ɣer ussik s wudem amaḍal. Ovulation tezmer ad tettwazeggel, ad d-teḍru war ma ttwalint, neɣ ur d-teḍri ara deg kra n cycles.
PcosCycleFertility.18: Wagi d yiwen seg ssebbat ayɣer i izemren kra n tilawin i sɛan PCOS ad sɛun cycles n 35, 45, neɣ kra n tikkal ugar n wussan, mara yeḥwaǧ wiyaḍ ad sɛun cycles i yeqqnen ɣer umatu.
PcosCycleFertility.20: Aɣezfan n cycle kan ur d-yeqqar ara ma teḍra ovulation. Sin n cycles n yiwen n uɣezfan zemren ad sɛun amezruy n hormone yemgaraden.
PcosCycleFertility.21: Ovulation d tuffɣa n tamellalt seg yiwen n useksaw. Tettwali aswir n useggem n follicule, ad d-tas send aswir lutéal n cycle.
PcosCycleFertility.22: Deg cycle amaḍal, ovulation s waṭas tella ɣer talemmast. Maca deg PCOS, ddemma-a tamellalt ur tettwaḥerreẓ ara yal tikkelt. Ovulation tezmer ad tili aṭas deg zzman neɣ ur d-teḍri ara deg cycle yettwaswayen.
PcosCycleFertility.24: Mi ara tili ovulation ur yelli ara d ayen yettwaḥerrzen, yettuɣal yewɛer ad tt-id-tesmektiyeḍ aẓrag n tmerna s ussaɣ n wussan n lḥiḍ kan.
PcosCycleFertility.25: Llan aṭas n ticraḍ n ugraw i izemren ad d-ilin ɣer usnifel n hormone ɣer ovulation. Zemren ad ttwasqedcen akken ad tḥerzeḍ cycle-ik, maca ula d yiwen ur izmir ad yessaḥ ovulation s tidet.
PcosCycleFertility.26: Asnifel n tidimt n ɛenq n tebburt, tezmer ad tuɣal d tameqqrant, tafessast, tezzulut
PcosCycleFertility.27: Aḍṛar yeḥfifen neɣ ugur deg uḍar n teɣmert i kra n tilawin
PcosCycleFertility.28: Asnifel n uḥemmum n ugraw seld ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.30: Tuggunt yezmer ad d-tili n tuḥemmit deg kra n tilawin
PcosCycleFertility.31: Tidimt n ɛenq n tebburt tfaq ad tettwamuqel s wudem uslig. Mi ara tqeṛṛeb tallunt n tannumi, tezmer ad tuɣal d tameqqrant, tafessast, tazelsat, tezzulut. Maca, udem-is yezmer ad yemgarad seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ d seg cycle ɣer cycle.
PcosCycleFertility.33: Ɣer cycles ur yelli ara d imaḍalen, azmiz n ovulation i yettwaḥseb s wudem awurman seg cycles n zik yezmer ad yili d aqeṛṛeb kan. Tarmit mačči d asenqed n ṭṭbib n ovulation.
PcosCycleFertility.34: PCOS tezmer ad tesbaw tamerna, s wudem uslig mi ara tili ovulation d tazzayt neɣ yewɛer ad tt-id-tsewweḍ. Maca, ma tesɛiḍ PCOS ur yelli ara d dakken ur tezmireḍ ara ad tmerneḍ.
PcosCycleFertility.35: Kra n tilawin i sɛan PCOS ttsewwiḍent ovulation s wudem amaḍal, ttmernant war ugur uslig. I wiyaḍ, ovulation ur tettili ara d tamaḍalt, ilaq asenqed, ahat ula d tallunt n ṭṭbib.
PcosCycleFertility.36: PCOS ur d-ittawi ara s wudem awurman ur tmerneḍ ara
PcosCycleFertility.37: Ugur agejdan s waṭas d ovulation ur yelli ara d amaḍal neɣ ur yettwaḥerrez ara
PcosCycleFertility.38: Ovulation tezmer ad d-teḍru ula ma cycles ǧǧan d iɣezfanen aṭas
PcosCycleFertility.39: Tallunt yelhan tezmer ad terr tuffra n tmerna d tameqqrant
PcosCycleFertility.40: Abrid n tmerna yettɛalaq ɣer yal yiwet d waṭas n ilmend niḍen
PcosCycleFertility.41: Tamerna ur tettɛalaq ara ula d ovulation kan. Leɛmer, tikli n wudem n umdan, ibuqqes n yitruyen n teɣmert, endomètre, d ilmend niḍen zemren ad ɛawnen daɣen. Dagi i d acraḍ n tuqqna tamatut i yilaqen mi ara teddu tmerna aṭas n wakud.
PcosCycleFertility.42: Isnasen n usentel n lḥiḍ ttseqdacen s waṭas isefka n cycles n zik akken ad ssirwen tikli n wakud. Mi ara llan cycles imaḍalen, isefka-a zemren ad d-ilin d aẓru.
PcosCycleFertility.43: Maca deg PCOS, usnifel n cycle yezmer ad yerr isefka-a ur d-ttilin ara d ayen n tidet. Asnas ur izmir ara ad yeẓṛ s tidet belli ovulation teḍra kan acku ass n tidet yewweḍ.
PcosCycleFertility.45: Asentel amḍan yelha s waṭas akken ad twaliḍ asnifel n cycle-ik d uḥerrez n umezruy ara tebḍuḍ d umaẓrag n lɛafit.
PcosCycleFertility.46: Asentel amaḍal yezmer ad k-ɛawen ad tfehmeḍ asnifel-ik. Iswi mačči d ad tserreḥeḍ cycle ad yili d ayen yettwaḥerrzen, maca d ad tezdeɣeḍ talɣut iwakken ad twaliḍ asnifel.
PcosCycleFertility.47: Ruẓ-d azemz n wass amezwaru n yal cycle, ula d ma cycles ttwabeɛden aṭas
PcosCycleFertility.48: Mmuqel asnifel n tidimt n ɛenq n tebburt deg cycle
PcosCycleFertility.49: Ruẓ-d yal aḍṛar n teɣmert neɣ ticraḍ niḍen i izemren ad d-ilin ɣer ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.50: Ur tettkeḍḍabeḍ ara kan ɣef uɣezfan amatu n 28 n wussan akken ad d-tefkeḍ ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.51: Seqdec iteggi n ovulation s lehna, ma yelzem suter tanṣiḥt n win yesɛan tussna
PcosCycleFertility.52: Bḍu talɣut i d-tezdiḍ d umaẓrag n lɛafit ma tebɣiḍ ad tmerneḍ
PcosCycleFertility.53: Yezmer daɣen ad k-ɛawen ad truẓeḍ ticraḍ i yettwaqqnen: aḍṛar, acne, asnifel n tidimt, idammen ur yelli ara d amaḍal, wul, anezgum, neɣ tamuɣli-nniḍen. Talɣut-a tezmer ad d-tefk tawlaft ugar n cycle-ik.
PcosCycleFertility.54: Tamsawalt tezmer ad telhu ula send ad tebduḍ ad tmerneḍ, ma cycles d iɣezfanen aṭas, ttwabeɛden aṭas, neɣ ma lḥiḍ ur d-yettili ara aṭas n wakud.
PcosCycleFertility.55: Amaẓrag n lɛafit yezmer ad yeẓẓi ssebbat n ugur, ad d-yefk azmiz n ovulation, d wayen ma yelzem, ad d-yernu tarrayt yellan akken ilaq i uɣrad-ik n lḥemmil.
PcosCycleFertility.57: Ma lḥiḍ-ik ttwabeɛden aṭas, ma ur d-yusi ara lḥiḍ-ik deg waṭas n wayyuren, neɣ ma ur tmerneḍ ara ɣas ma tesɛiḍ ittekkilen amaḍal, sawal ɣer umaẓrag n lɛafit.
PcosCycleFertility.59: PCOS tezmer ad tbeddel cycles ad uɣalen d iɣezfanen, ur d-yettwaḥerrzen ara.
PcosCycleFertility.60: Ovulation tezmer ad tili ur yelli ara d tamaḍalt neɣ ad tettwarr deg kra n cycles.
PcosCycleFertility.61: Cycle ur yelli ara d amaḍal ur yeqqar ara s wudem awurman belli ur tesɛiḍ ara tamerna.
PcosCycleFertility.62: Tisewwiyin i yebnan kan ɣef uɣmis zemrent ad ttwalint ur llint ara d tidet deg PCOS.
PcosCycleFertility.63: Asenqed n cycle-ik d uḥerrez n umezruy zemren ad lhun, s wudem uslig i tmesawalt.
PcosCycleFertility.65: PCOS ur d-tettbegan ara akken kif kif deg yal tameṭṭut. Cycle-ik yezmer ad yettbeddil s wakud. Asentel yella akken ad k-ɛawen ad tfehmeḍ amek i yettxeddem ugraw-ik, mačči ad d-yernu tanṣiḥt n ṭṭbib.
PcosCycleFertility.66: Amagrad-a yettunefk kan i talɣut d uselmed. Ur d-yettaf ara asenqed n ṭṭbib, ur d-yettɛawad ara tamsawalt d umaẓrag n lɛafit.
PcosCycleFertility.67: Cycle, ovulation, d tmerna deg PCOS — AWA

PcosDiagnosis.1:
Asenqed n PCOS:
isenqed d wuguren
PcosDiagnosis.6: Amek i yettwasenqed PCOS, d acu n isenqed i izemren ad ttunefken, d amek ara tsewweḍ i termit-ik s lehna.
PcosDiagnosis.15: Asenqed n PCOS ur yettwasenqed ara s yiwen n usenqed kan. Amaẓrag n lɛafit yelqem aṭas n telɣut: amezruy n cycle-ik, ticraḍ yellan, asenqed n ugraw, isenqed n laboratwar, d ultrason almend n tmeẓẓi.
PcosDiagnosis.16: Iswi d ad nemmuqel i ticraḍ i yeqqnen ɣer PCOS d ad nefk i ssebbat niḍen i izemren ad d-ssefhmen lḥiḍ ur yelli ara d amaḍal neɣ kra n ticraḍ n hormone.
PcosDiagnosis.18: Asenqed yettwaswayen i yal yiwet. Sin n tilawin i sɛan PCOS zemrent ad sɛunt ticraḍ d igmuḍ yemgaraden aṭas.
PcosDiagnosis.19: Asenqed yezmer ad ṭṭef aṭas n yiswiren. Ur ttwaxdemen ara akk akken kif kif i yal yiwet.
PcosDiagnosis.21: Amaẓrag yelqem amezruy-ik: cycles, ticraḍ, amezruy n ddwa, d yinig.
PcosDiagnosis.23: Yettnadi s wudem uslig ticraḍ n androgène aṭaṭ, yettwali aswir amatu n ugraw-ik.
PcosDiagnosis.25: Isenqed n hormone d n métabolisme zemren ad ttwasuturen akken ad d-bnun tamsalt.
PcosDiagnosis.27: Yezmer ad yekmel asenqed s wakud n twalit n yiseksawen.
PcosDiagnosis.33: Asenqed n idammen yezmer ad yettunefk akken ad d-tfeḍ ticraḍ n androgène aṭaṭ, ad yettwasenqed kra n hormone yeqqnen ɣer tikli n tmerna, d ad yettwanad ssebbat niḍen n ticraḍ-ik.
PcosDiagnosis.34: Isenqed i yettwafernen ttɛalaqen ɣer leɛmer-ik, ticraḍ-ik, amezruy-ik n ddwa, d wayen i yebɣa amaẓrag ad isenqed.
PcosDiagnosis.36: Testostérone d hormone niḍen almend n tmeẓẓi.
PcosDiagnosis.38: Ittɛawan s wudem uslig ad yefk kra n ssebbat n cycles ur yelli ara d imaḍalen.
PcosDiagnosis.40: Sukkar deg idammen, kra n tikkal asenqed n lipides almend n ilmend n tuggdi.
PcosDiagnosis.42: Igmuḍ n hormone ilaq ad ttwasmekten d tmeẓẓi n tmuɣli n ṭṭbib. Yiwen n wazal ur yettwakfa ara s wudem ameqqran akken ad yeqqar PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.43: Ultrason yezmer ad yettwasqedec akken ad yettwali udem n yiseksawen, ad yettwanad s wudem uslig ugar n follicule imeẓẓyanen. Yefk daɣen i umaẓrag ad d-yanad ilmend niḍen i izemren ad d-ssefhmen kra n ticraḍ.
PcosDiagnosis.45: Ma twaliḍ aṭas n follicule deg ultrason, ur yeqqar ara s wudem awurman belli tesɛiḍ PCOS. Agmuḍ ilaq ad yettwasmekti d wayen i d-yeqqim n usenqed.
PcosDiagnosis.46: Mi ara d-tali talɣut n PCOS, ur yefk ara ad tt-id-tsewweḍ amek ara tekkes tallunt-ik. Asyndrom yezmer ad d-yettbeggen s wudem yemgaraden aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
PcosDiagnosis.47: PCOS ur d-yeqqar ara s wudem awurman ur tmerneḍ ara.
PcosDiagnosis.48: PCOS ur yeqqar ara belli tesɛiḍ kista.
PcosDiagnosis.49: Asenqed kan ur yefk ara adwa.
PcosDiagnosis.50: Ultrason amaḍal ur yeqqar ara s wudem uslig belli ulac PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.51: Kra n telɣut i tḥeggeḍ send zzman tezmer ad tɛawen amaẓrag ad yefhem amezruy-ik d ad ifren isenqed i yesɛan assaɣ.
PcosDiagnosis.52: Acḥal n zzman i yezga cycle-ik ur yelli ara d amaḍal?
PcosDiagnosis.53: Tbeggneḍ acne, aṭaṭ n ccwari ur yelli ara d amaḍal, neɣ ufeɣ n ccwari?
PcosDiagnosis.54: Yella amezruy n twacult n PCOS neɣ n ṣṣukkar?
PcosDiagnosis.55: Tebɣiḍ ad tmerneḍ deg zzman aqeṛṛeb neɣ alemmas?
PcosDiagnosis.57: Ma tzemreḍ, ruẓ-d wussan n lḥiḍ-ik aneggaru, aɣezfan amatu n cycles-ik, ticraḍ i twaliḍ, d ddwa neɣ ibuqqes i tettawiḍ.
PcosDiagnosis.59: Asenqed yettwabna ɣef aṭas n wayen, mačči ɣef yiwen n usenqed kan.
PcosDiagnosis.60: Asenqed n idammen yezmer ad yettnadi kra n tkili n hormone ur nelli ara d tameqqrant, ad yekkes ssebbat niḍen.
PcosDiagnosis.61: Ultrason yezmer ad yekmel asenqed almend n tmeẓẓi.
PcosDiagnosis.62: Igmuḍ ilaq ad ttwasmektin yal tikkelt sɣur umaẓrag n lɛafit.
PcosDiagnosis.64: Asenqed n PCOS mačči d yiwen n usenqed neɣ d lḥekm aneggaru. Ittɛawan ad tfehmeḍ amek i yettxeddem hormone-ik, ad d-tafeḍ ssebbat niḍen, d ad tbnuḍ tallunt yelhan i tmeẓẓi-ik.
PcosDiagnosis.65: Amagrad-a yettunefk kan i talɣut, ur d-yettɛawad ara tamsawalt n ṭṭbib neɣ asmekti yettwaswayen n igmuḍ n isenqed-ik.

PcosHormonalAcne.6: Ayɣer i izemren acne n hormone ad d-yili d PCOS, amek ara t-tessneḍ, d acu n tiririn i izemren ad ɛawnent ad tt-tḥekmeḍ.
PcosHormonalAcne.7: Yettwali aṭas n tilawin, mačči d aṭṭbib n tazmert neɣ d ayen ur nezmir ara ad nbeddel: ma tfehmeḍ ansa d-tekka, ad tt-tḥekmeḍ akken ilaq.
PcosHormonalAcne.9: D acu i d acne n hormone?
PcosHormonalAcne.10: Ayɣer i izemren PCOS ad d-yawi acne?
PcosHormonalAcne.11: Amek ara tessneḍ acne n hormone
PcosHormonalAcne.12: Acne n hormone d cycle n lḥiḍ
PcosHormonalAcne.13: D acu i izemren ad ɛawen
PcosHormonalAcne.16: D acu i d acne n hormone?
PcosHormonalAcne.17: Acne n hormone d anaw n acne yeqqnen ɣer usnifel n hormone neɣ ur yelli ara d amaḍal, s wudem uslig deg androgène. Ur yelli ara am acne amatu n tegrawt, s waṭas yettwali tilawin timeqqranin, yezmer ad yettqimen neɣ ad d-yeḍru seld aswir-a.
PcosHormonalAcne.18: Yettemgarad daɣen s wadig-is, s lɛumq-is, d tikli-is n tuɣalin deg yiwen n wadig ɣas ma yettwaxdem usegmi amaḍal n uglim.
PcosHormonalAcne.20: Acne n hormone ur yeqqnen ara ɣer ukkes n ṭṭhara: asfaḍ n udem aṭas ur yeḥkem ara, yezmer ad yessemɣer aglim.
PcosHormonalAcne.21: Ayɣer i izemren PCOS ad d-yawi acne?
PcosHormonalAcne.22: Deg PCOS, aṭaṭ amassan n androgène yessemɣer tigeddiwin n wuɣen, ad snernint aṭaṭ n wuɣen. Kra n yiglimen ttwalin ugar n hormone-a, ayen i d-yessefhamen ayɣer i izemren acne ad yili d ameqqran ula d war usnifel ameqqran yettwasnen deg laboratwar.
PcosHormonalAcne.23: Wagi mačči d tamsalt n lebɣi: tamentilt-a tettemgarad seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ, ur tettɛalaq ara ɣer iɛadaten n tudert-ik.
PcosHormonalAcne.24: Amek ara tessneḍ acne n hormone
PcosHormonalAcne.25: Kra n ticraḍ ttuɣalen s waṭas, maca ur d-ttuɣalen ara yal tikkelt:
PcosHormonalAcne.26: Adwa n wudem n ddaw: tasga n tgemmi, ɣer tbuqqect
PcosHormonalAcne.27: Ibuqqes yellan d imeqqranen, kra n tikkal ttḥeṛṛiqen
PcosHormonalAcne.28: S waṭas ttuɣalen deg yiwen n wadig
PcosHormonalAcne.30: Acne n hormone d cycle n lḥiḍ
PcosHormonalAcne.31: Acne n hormone yezmer ad yettbeddil deg cycle. Aṭas n tilawin ttwalint ad yettwali ugar deg wussan send lḥiḍ, mi ara yettalay progestérone sakin ad d-yenqes s tezmert, ayen yessnernayen cwiṭ n wuɣen.
PcosHormonalAcne.33: Ma truẓeḍ melmi i d-ttbeggnen ibuqqes almend n cycle-ik, ad yaweḍ ad tfehmeḍ assaɣ n hormone d aṭṭbib n uglim.
PcosHormonalAcne.34: D acu i izemren ad ɛawen
PcosHormonalAcne.35: Kra n iɛadaten tilemmasin n uḥerrez zemrent ad ɛawnent ad tḥekmeḍ ugar, war ma ten-yekkes akk s wudem ameẓẓuɣ:
PcosHormonalAcne.36: Sfaḍ aglim-ik s lehna s ṣṣbaḥ d tmeddit
PcosHormonalAcne.37: Ur tseqdac ara imsulta tiḥeṛṛiqin neɣ yessekksen aṭas n yiglimen
PcosHormonalAcne.38: Ḥrez aglim-ik seg yiṭij yal ass
PcosHormonalAcne.39: Ur tkeččem ara neɣ ur tessuffeɣeḍ ara ibuqqes
PcosHormonalAcne.40: Almend n tmeẓẓi, aṭṭbib n uglim neɣ n tegnikulujt zemren ad d-snernin ddwa n ddaw (crèmes, gels) neɣ, ma yelzem, ddwa n hormone yelhan.
PcosHormonalAcne.41: Ur tesseqdac ara ddwa s yiman-ik
PcosHormonalAcne.42: Ddwa n acne n hormone (ddaw neɣ n hormone) ilaq ad yettwaru yettwaḥerrez sɣur umaẓrag n lɛafit, s wudem uslig ma tebɣiḍ ad tmerneḍ.
PcosHormonalAcne.44: Tanṣiḥt n ṭṭbib telha s wudem uslig deg kra n tallunin:
PcosHormonalAcne.45: Acne i yettqimen ɣas ma yettwaxdem usegmi ilhan
PcosHormonalAcne.46: Ibuqqes ittḥeṛṛiqen neɣ yellan d imeqqranen (nodules, kystes)
PcosHormonalAcne.47: Acne iweɛren neɣ i ineggan s tazmert
PcosHormonalAcne.51: Acne n hormone sɛa ssebba yettwasnen, yeqqnen ɣer androgène.
PcosHormonalAcne.52: S waṭas yettwali deg udem n ddaw, yezmer ad yeqqim ugar send lḥiḍ.
PcosHormonalAcne.53: Ur yelli ara d ukkes n ṭṭhara, ur yelli ara d ayen ur nezmir ara ad nbeddel.
PcosHormonalAcne.54: Asegmi amaḍal d wanaw yelhan n ddwa zemren ad ssemɣren.
PcosHormonalAcne.55: Aṭṭbib n uglim neɣ n tegnikulujt zemren ad k-ɛawen ma yeqqim.
PcosHormonalAcne.57: Amagrad-a yettunefk kan i talɣut tamatut, ur d-yettɛawad ara tamsawalt d ṭṭbib. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek neɣ ma ticraḍ qqimen, suter tanṣiḥt n umaẓrag n lɛafit.

PcosIntro.6: Asyndrom n yiseksawen s waṭas n kystes, yettwaxeddem s waṭas PCOS, d ugur amatu n hormone i izemren ad yesɛu tikli ɣef cycles-ik, ovulation, uglim, ccwari, métabolisme, d kra n tikkal tamerna.
PcosIntro.7: Amek i d-yettbeggen yemgarad aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ. Ma tfehmeḍ PCOS, ad ak-yɛawen s wudem uslig ad tessneḍ ticraḍ-is, ad tessneḍ melmi ara tessuturem tanṣiḥt n ṭṭbib, d ad tḥerzeḍ asnifel-is war ma tessmuqleḍ iman-ik.
PcosIntro.16: Aglim, ccwari, d ccwari n ugraw
PcosIntro.18: Ticraḍ ur nelli ara d tidet
PcosIntro.22: Asyndrom n yiseksawen s waṭas n kystes (PCOS) d ugur amatu n hormone i izemren ad ibeddel tikli tamenzut n yiseksawen d umizzan n kra n hormone.
PcosIntro.23: I kra n tilawin, ugur agejdan d ovulation ur yelli ara d tamaḍalt. I wiyaḍ, d acne, aṭaṭ n ccwari, ukkes n ccwari, neɣ ticraḍ n métabolisme i d-yettbeggen d ayen amezwaru.
PcosIntro.25: Ɣas akken isem-is, PCOS ur yeqqar ara dakken iseksawen sɛan “kystes.” Awal amezruy-ines yezmer ad k-yeḥbes, ultrason kan ur d-yeqqar ara asenqed.

PcosMetabolism.6: Assaɣ gar PCOS, uzɣal, d tamentilt n insuline — war ma tessmuqleḍ iman-ik, war yibdan.
PcosMetabolism.10: Uzɣal: d acu i d tidet d acu ur nelli ara d tidet

PcosMetabolism.14: PCOS s waṭas tettwaqqen d usnifel n métabolisme, ula d tamentilt n insuline. Maca, assaɣ-a ur yeqqen ara kan ɣer tilawin yesɛan aṭaṭ n uzɣal — udem n métabolisme yemgarad seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
PcosMetabolism.15: Insuline d hormone ittɛawan tisellalin ad seqdacent glucose deg idammen. Mi ara tili tamentilt n insuline, tisellalin ttjawabent drus i hormone-a, ameğğuy yezmer ad d-yessuffeɣ ugar n insuline.
PcosMetabolism.16: Deg PCOS, wagi yezmer ad yeqqen ɣer ugar n tuffɣa n androgène, yezmer ad yesɛu tikli ɣef kra n ticraḍ. Maca ur sɛant ara akk tilawin i sɛan PCOS udem n métabolisme kif kif.
PcosMetabolism.18: Tamentilt n insuline tezmer ad tettwasenqed s isenqed n idammen mi ara yeqqar aṭṭbib belli telha. Ma yelzem usenqed neɣ ala, yettɛalaq ɣer tmeẓẓi-ik.
PcosMetabolism.19: PCOS tesɛa tikli ɣef tilawin n yal udem n ugraw, seg tilawin yellan d tizewwaɣin ɣer tilawin yesɛan uzɣal.

PcosMetabolism.23: Iswi mačči d ad tnadiḍ uzɣal “ilhan”, maca d ad tbnuḍ iɛadaten tilemmasin, yellan, yettqimen. Tuccant yelhan, tikli, d anezgum amaḍal zemren ad ɛawnent tazmert n métabolisme.
